tactics:
have key : ∀ a b (s : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive✝) s ∧ motive✝ a b s := by
  intro a b s
  induction s with
  | slnil => exact ⟨(by first | trivial | exact ⟨⟩), F _ _ _ (by first | trivial | exact ⟨⟩)⟩
  | cons x h ih => exact ⟨(by first | exact ⟨ih.1, ih.2⟩ | exact ⟨ih.2, ih.1⟩), F _ _ _ (by first | exact ⟨ih.1, ih.2⟩ | exact ⟨ih.2, ih.1⟩)⟩
  | cons₂ x h ih => exact ⟨(by first | exact ⟨ih.1, ih.2⟩ | exact ⟨ih.2, ih.1⟩), F _ _ _ (by first | exact ⟨ih.1, ih.2⟩ | exact ⟨ih.2, ih.1⟩)⟩

have key : ∀ a b (s : List.Sublist a b), List.Sublist.below (motive := motive✝) s ∧ motive✝ a b s := by
  intro a b s
  induction s <;> constructor <;> first | trivial | exact ⟨‹_›.1, ‹_›.2⟩ | exact ⟨‹_›.2, ‹_›.1⟩ | (apply F; first | trivial | exact ⟨‹_›.1, ‹_›.2⟩ | exact ⟨‹_›.2, ‹_›.1⟩)
